Good morning. Do you need help with the map?
Good morning. Yes, please. How do I get to the Louvre?
By train. Take line one, and change at Chatelet.
Line one, and I change at Chatelet. How many stops is that?
Four stops, then two more on line seven. It is very simple.
And how long does it take?
About twenty-eight minutes, with the walk to the platform.
Perfect. And the tower? How far is it from the Louvre?
It is four kilometers. You can take the bus, number sixty-nine.
And can we walk? My daughter wants to see the streets.
Yes, you can. It is fifty minutes on foot, and it is a beautiful walk.

Good morning, and welcome on line one. The next stop is Chatelet. At Chatelet you can change to line four, line seven and line eleven. From Chatelet to the last station it takes fourteen minutes. Please take all your bags with you when you go out. If you have a big bag, please stay near the door and let the other people go out first. The train is very full in the morning, from eight to ten. Thank you, and have a good day in Paris.

Hello, and thank you for calling the city bus information line. Here is the information for bus number sixty-nine. The bus goes from Bastille to the tower. It takes twenty-five minutes in the morning, but it can take forty minutes in the afternoon. Your bus stop is two hundred meters from the hotel, in the same street, in front of the small green park. A bus comes every eight minutes. If the bus is full, please wait for the next one. You can pay with a card on the bus. Thank you, and have a very good day.
How do I get to the Louvre? Where do I change trains? How long does it take? How far is the tower from the Louvre? Thank you. We can walk from there.
